title: Professional Certificate Course in Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
description: To provide learners with a comprehensive understanding of Artificial Intelligence concepts, techniques, applications, and ethical implications.
longDescription: Explain the fundamental concepts, history, and evolution of Artificial Intelligence. Differentiate between key AI techniques, including machine learning, expert systems, and neural networks. Evaluate the applications of Artificial Intelligence across business, healthcare, education, governance, and other sectors. Assess the ethical, legal, and societal implications associated with the development and deployment of AI technologies. Demonstrate a foundational understanding of AI tools and technologies used to solve real-world problems. This course introduces the fundamental concepts, principles, and applications of Artificial Intelligence (AI) across various industries. It explores intelligent systems, machine learning, knowledge representation, and problem-solving techniques used in AI. Learners will examine ethical considerations, emerging AI technologies, and their societal impact. The course equips students with a foundational understanding of AI and its role in digital transformation and innovation.
